snippet.title: LIVING HELL - Release Window & Playtest Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about LIVING HELL: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078760/LIVING_HELL/

From the creator of DEVOUR, ​​LIVING HELL is a new 1–4 player co-op survival horror game set in Pelican City. The collapse of the ozone layer exposed the city to devastating solar radiation, triggering widespread and terrifying mutations. Capture mutated specimens and turn them into biofuel to power your train: your last chance to reach one of the remaining rockets and escape Earth.

The first LIVING HELL playtest is now live on Steam, with the full game launching Summer 2027. Choose from 6 unique characters, survive 12+ mutated creatures, and scavenge, craft, and fight your way to safety.

LIVING HELL Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078760/LIVING_HELL/

--

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
